form:HelpHTML.p: The type of volume to store data in.

ul.li: Standard - Store data on the local/remote file system at the specified path.
S3 v1 - Store data in an S3-compatible object storage service using the configuration provided in the S3 Configuration section below. Data is stored in S3 as a single Zip file.

S3 v1 (Read only) - Store data in an S3-compatible object storage service using the configuration provided in the S3 Configuration section below. Data is stored in S3 as a single Zip file. This volume is intended for use when Stroom-Proxy creates the files on S3. The files are read only from Stroom's perspective, it CANNOT delete the files, only the stream metadata.

S3 v2 (Experimental) - Store data in an S3-compatible object storage service using the configuration provided in the S3 Configuration section below. Data is stored in S3 as one or more ZStandard compressed files. WARNING This is an experimental feature and is not suitable for production use.

form:FormGroup.label: Path
form:FormGroup.helpText: The directory path to store the data in. Not applicable to S3 volumes.

form:HelpHTML.p: The status of the volume controlling how it can be used.

ul.li: Active - The volume is active and can be used for reading and writing data.
Inactive - The volume will no longer be written to, but can be used for reading data.
Closed - The data has been removed and the volume is closed. No more data can be written to it.

form:FormGroup.label: Limit
form:FormGroup.helpText: The maximum amount of data that can be stored on this volume. Not applicable to S3 based volumes.

form:FormGroup.label: S3 Configuration
form:FormGroup.helpText: The JSON configuration for the S3 volume.
